blank.title: The Unwritten Legend
blank.sentence: No traits were submitted this time. This player's next adventure is still a blank page.

supportive.title: The Team's Emergency Lighthouse
supportive.sentence: Whenever a teammate went down this round, a supportive figure was already on the way with a medkit and a pep talk.
extra: And through all of it, still supportive enough to drag a teammate back to safety.
Somewhere in the middle of that, a supportive hand pulled someone out of trouble.

strategic.title: The Pocket-Sized Grandmaster
strategic.sentence: Somebody spent this round playing chess while everyone else played tag. A strategic performance down to the last move.
extra: There was, apparently, a strategic reason for all of it.
The team suspects every bit of that was part of a strategic master plan.

funny.title: The Respawn Comedy Club
funny.sentence: The match may have gone sideways, but the commentary was genuinely funny from the first respawn to the last.
extra: And it was funny the entire way through, which counts for a lot.
Whatever else happened, the running commentary was funny enough to save the evening.

creative.title: The Improvised Strategy Department
creative.sentence: Nobody else would have thought to solve that problem with a chair and a grappling hook. A truly creative round.
extra: Points also go to one creative solution that no guide would ever recommend.
Add a creative workaround or two, and the round starts to make sense.

patient.title: The Unshakeable Quest Captain
patient.sentence: Three wipes, two loading screens and one escort mission later, this patient player had not sighed even once.
extra: And all of it was handled by someone patient enough to wait out the longest loading screen.
Through every restart this player stayed patient, which is more than the rest of the team managed.

adaptable.title: The Walking Backup Plan
adaptable.sentence: The plan changed four times this round, and this adaptable player was already doing the new one each time.
extra: When things changed, this player was adaptable enough to act like it was the plan all along.
Luckily, an adaptable mind had a new plan ready before the old one finished failing.

encouraging.title: The Portable Pep-Talk Machine
encouraging.sentence: Even after a spectacular team wipe, one encouraging voice insisted the next attempt would be the one.
extra: And an encouraging word arrived right when morale needed it.
The whole time, this player kept up an encouraging stream of "we've got this".

clutch.title: The Last-Second Specialist
clutch.sentence: With one health point and no time left, this player pulled off the clutch play that the team will be retelling for weeks.
extra: Then, with everything on the line, came the clutch moment that fixed it.
And when it finally mattered, the clutch finish was right on time.

reckless.title: The Red-Button Expedition Leader
reckless.sentence: If there was a button marked "do not press", this reckless explorer pressed it twice to be sure.
extra: Then came one reckless detour that nobody will forget.
There was also a reckless dash through the one room everybody agreed to avoid.

distracted.title: The Side Quest Magnet
distracted.sentence: The objective was straight ahead. This distracted wanderer went left, to look at a particularly interesting rock.
extra: For part of it, this player was distracted by something shiny off the edge of the map.
Somewhere along the way a side quest appeared, and a distracted hero went to take a look.

hesitant.title: The Boss-Door Philosopher
hesitant.sentence: The boss door stood open for a full minute while this hesitant hero considered every possible outcome.
extra: There was also a hesitant pause at the doorway while the options were weighed.
Before any of that, a hesitant moment at the threshold lasted slightly longer than planned.

impatient.title: The Fast-Forward Adventurer
impatient.sentence: Doors, cutscenes and countdowns all learned the same lesson this round: this player is far too impatient to wait for them.
extra: All of it happened at speed, because this player was far too impatient to slow down.
The countdown had barely started before an impatient thumb skipped it.

overconfident.title: The One-HP Victory Announcer
overconfident.sentence: Victory was announced at one health point and with three enemies still standing. An overconfident forecast, as it turned out.
extra: Along the way came one overconfident victory speech, delivered slightly too early.
The health bar disagreed with one overconfident prediction, but the delivery was flawless.

chaotic.title: The Accidental Fireworks Director
chaotic.sentence: Nobody knows what the plan was, including this player. A chaotic round, with a surprising number of explosions.
extra: The rest was a chaotic blur that the replay still cannot explain.
And then things got chaotic, in a way that no briefing covered.

stubborn.title: The Immovable Objective
stubborn.sentence: The same door, the same approach, seven attempts. This stubborn challenger was certain the eighth would work.
extra: Meanwhile, a stubborn refusal to change the route carried on regardless.
The plan stayed exactly the same throughout, thanks to one stubborn believer.

greedy.title: The Loot Goblin in Chief
greedy.sentence: Every chest, crate and suspicious barrel was emptied before the team arrived. A greedy round, and a very full backpack.
extra: On the way, a greedy hand found its way into every loot chest.
The backpack tells its own story: this player was greedy with the loot again.

energetic.title: The Human Loading Screen Skip
energetic.sentence: While the team was still reading the mission brief, this energetic player had already circled the map twice.
extra: All of it was done by someone energetic enough to power the respawn screen.
And through the whole round, this player stayed energetic enough for the entire squad.

lucky.title: The Fortune Cookie Champion
lucky.sentence: The dice rolled, bounced off a wall and landed exactly where this lucky player needed them.
extra: And somehow lucky enough to walk away without a scratch.
The lucky bounce at the end did not hurt either.

cautious.title: The Seatbelt-Equipped Explorer
cautious.sentence: Every corner was checked and every chest was poked with a stick first. A cautious expedition from start to finish.
extra: Credit where due: one cautious peek around the corner saved the day.
Before any of it, a cautious check for traps came first.

adventurous.title: The Side Quest Navigator
adventurous.sentence: The marked path was right there. This adventurous traveller took the unmarked one, and found a whole new area.
extra: There was also an adventurous detour through a part of the map nobody had opened yet.
Somewhere in there, an adventurous shortcut turned into the scenic route.

quiet.title: The Stealth-Mode Teammate
quiet.sentence: Not a word on voice chat, and then the objective was simply done. A quiet round with loud results.
extra: Most of it was done by someone so quiet that the team checked the connection twice.
And the whole time, this player stayed quiet and let the scoreboard do the talking.

talkative.title: The Play-by-Play Announcer
talkative.sentence: Every step, every reload and every snack was narrated live. A talkative round, and nobody had to check the minimap.
extra: All of it came with live narration from a very talkative commentator.
The team heard about every second of it, because this player was feeling talkative.

sneaky.title: The Shadow in the Corner
sneaky.sentence: Nobody saw this player for most of the round, and then the flag was gone. A sneaky piece of work.
extra: Then came a sneaky route around the back that nobody saw coming.
Part of it happened out of sight, courtesy of one sneaky shortcut.

competitive.title: The Scoreboard Watcher
competitive.sentence: It was announced as a casual round. This competitive player was checking the scoreboard before the countdown ended.
extra: For the record, a competitive eye was on the scoreboard the whole time.
And being competitive, this player has already asked for a rematch.

supportive+strategic: Supportive enough to cover every teammate and strategic enough to know exactly where they should be standing.
supportive+funny: Revives arrive with a joke attached: a supportive teammate who is funny even while carrying the squad to safety.
supportive+creative: A supportive teammate with a creative streak: help always arrives, just never by the route anyone expected.
supportive+patient: Supportive and patient in the same round: explained the mechanic four times and cheered on the fifth attempt.
supportive+adaptable: Whatever the squad was missing, this adaptable player became it. Supportive in three different roles before the first checkpoint.
supportive+encouraging: Supportive with the heals and encouraging on the mic. Morale has never been this well looked after.
supportive+clutch: A supportive teammate all round, and then one clutch revive with half a second left to prove it.
supportive+reckless: The Paramedic Who Runs Into Fires
Always supportive, occasionally reckless: the first to revive a teammate, usually from somewhere nobody should be standing.
supportive+distracted: The Helper Who Took the Scenic Route
Genuinely supportive, once the distracted detour past three side quests was over. The help was worth the wait.
supportive+hesitant: A supportive presence behind the team and a hesitant one in front of it. Nobody was left behind, mostly because nobody went first.
supportive+impatient: A supportive teammate with an impatient streak: you will be rescued, but please hurry up about it.
supportive+overconfident: The Bodyguard Who Promised Too Much
Supportive to the end and overconfident from the start: "I'll cover all of you" was a big offer from someone on one health point.
supportive+chaotic: The Whirlwind With a First-Aid Kit
Help arrived from every direction at once. A supportive effort delivered in the most chaotic way available.
supportive+stubborn: The Rescuer Who Would Not Leave
Too stubborn to abandon a downed teammate and too supportive to try. The revive took four attempts and was never in doubt.
supportive+greedy: Greedy at every chest and supportive at every fight: the backpack was full, but the potions were shared.
supportive+energetic: An energetic blur with a supportive mission: every teammate was checked on, twice, at a sprint.
supportive+lucky: Supportive by choice and lucky by nature. Help arrived on time mostly because the dice wanted it to.
supportive+cautious: Supportive and cautious in equal measure: nobody gets left behind, and nobody opens that chest without a second opinion.
supportive+adventurous: The Tour Guide With a Medkit
Adventurous enough to lead the squad off the map and supportive enough to get every one of them back.
supportive+quiet: Never said a word, never missed a heal. A quiet round from the most supportive player on the team.
supportive+talkative: A supportive teammate and a talkative one: every heal came with advice, a compliment and a weather update.
supportive+sneaky: A sneaky figure nobody noticed, until the revive came from nowhere. Supportive work done entirely from the shadows.
supportive+competitive: The Captain Who Wants Everyone to Win
Competitive about the scoreboard and supportive about the squad: this player wants first place, for all of you.
strategic+funny: A strategic briefing that doubled as a stand-up set. The plan worked, and it was funny enough that people listened.
strategic+creative: Strategic thinking with a creative twist: the plan was sound, it just involved a ladder nobody knew the game had.
strategic+patient: Strategic enough to set the trap and patient enough to wait eleven minutes for it to work.
strategic+adaptable: A strategic plan that survived contact with the enemy, only because this adaptable player rewrote it mid-fight.
strategic+encouraging: Strategic on the whiteboard and encouraging in the huddle: everyone knew the plan and believed it might work.
strategic+clutch: A strategic setup all round, cashed in with a clutch finish that looked planned. It probably was.
strategic+reckless: The Grandmaster Who Flips the Board
Drew up a strategic masterpiece, then made the reckless decision to ignore it in the first ten seconds.
strategic+distracted: The Genius Who Left the Room
The strategic plan was excellent. Its author, distracted by a side quest, was not there to see it happen.
strategic+hesitant: The Planner at the Starting Line
A strategic mind with a hesitant trigger finger: the plan was perfect, and still being reviewed when the round began.
strategic+impatient: Strategic enough to plan three moves ahead, too impatient to wait for the second one.
strategic+overconfident: The Mastermind Who Called It Early
A strategic plan with one overconfident assumption: that the enemy had also read it.
strategic+chaotic: The Strategist with a Confetti Cannon
A strategic opening, a chaotic middle, and an ending nobody can reconstruct. The plan may have been the confetti.
strategic+stubborn: The Architect of the One True Plan
The strategic plan was good. The stubborn commitment to it after it stopped working was truly impressive.
strategic+greedy: A strategic route through the level that happened to pass every single chest. Greedy, but beautifully organised.
strategic+energetic: Strategic orders delivered at an energetic sprint: the plan was clear, if you could keep up with it.
strategic+lucky: It was either a strategic masterstroke or a lucky accident. This player is not taking questions.
strategic+cautious: A strategic mind with a cautious heart: there was a plan, a backup plan, and a backup for the backup.
strategic+adventurous: An adventurous route that nobody had tried, backed by strategic reasoning that almost holds up.
strategic+quiet: The Chess Player in the Corner
Barely spoke all round, then the whole map fell into place. A quiet player running a strategic game in the background.
strategic+talkative: A strategic briefing that never really ended. Talkative, yes, but every sentence had a waypoint in it.
strategic+sneaky: A strategic trap and a sneaky hiding spot: the other team walked in exactly where the diagram said they would.
strategic+competitive: Competitive enough to care about every point and strategic enough to know where the next one was coming from.
funny+creative: A creative solution that should not have worked, explained in a way so funny that nobody minded when it didn't.
funny+patient: Patient through every wipe and funny about each one. The fifth attempt came with a new punchline.
funny+adaptable: The plan fell apart and this adaptable player turned it into a bit. Funny, and somehow still useful.
funny+encouraging: Funny when the team was losing and encouraging when it was really losing. Nobody logged off sad.
funny+clutch: The Comedian Who Lands the Punchline
Spent the round being funny on the mic, then pulled off a clutch play mid-joke without missing a beat.
funny+reckless: A reckless jump off the highest ledge, narrated on the way down. It did not work, but it was very funny.
funny+distracted: Got distracted by a chicken, followed it for two minutes, and came back with a story funny enough to justify it.
funny+hesitant: Hesitant at the door, but funny about it: the list of reasons not to go in deserved its own show.
funny+impatient: Too impatient for the cutscene and funny enough to replace it with better dialogue.
funny+overconfident: The overconfident acceptance speech began before the fight did. The way it ended was funny for everyone else.
funny+chaotic: A chaotic round with perfect comic timing. It is unclear whether any of it was on purpose, but it was funny.
funny+stubborn: A stubborn refusal to stop trying the same trick, which got funny somewhere around the sixth attempt.
funny+greedy: Greedy with every chest and funny about it: each theft came with a small apology and a bow.
funny+energetic: An energetic stream of bits, voices and sound effects. Funny for the whole round, with no sign of running out.
funny+lucky: A lucky bounce won the round in the silliest way possible, and this player was funny enough to take full credit.
funny+cautious: Cautious about every doorway, and funny about it too: the risk assessment got a laugh from the whole squad.
funny+adventurous: The Tour Guide of Terrible Ideas
An adventurous trip to somewhere the map never intended, with commentary funny enough to bring the team along.
funny+quiet: Quiet for ten minutes, then one perfectly timed line that was funny enough to stop the match.
funny+talkative: Talkative from the lobby to the final screen, and funny for most of it. The mute button stayed untouched.
funny+sneaky: A sneaky ambush from inside a bush, and a funny little wave afterwards. The other team is still annoyed.
funny+competitive: Competitive enough to keep score out loud and funny enough that even the losing side was laughing.
creative+patient: A creative solution that needed nineteen careful steps, built by someone patient enough to do all of them.
creative+adaptable: Creative with the tools and adaptable with the rules: when the bridge was out, the bridge became optional.
creative+encouraging: The Art Teacher of the Squad
Encouraging about everyone's ideas, including the creative one involving a barrel. Especially that one.
creative+clutch: A creative angle nobody had tried, saved for the clutch moment when it absolutely had to work.
creative+reckless: A creative experiment with explosives, run by a reckless researcher standing much too close.
creative+distracted: Distracted from the objective, but for a creative reason: this player was building a staircase out of crates.
creative+hesitant: The Inventor Who Wouldn't Press Start
A creative idea, fully designed, and a hesitant hand hovering over the button for most of the round.
creative+impatient: Too impatient for the intended route, and creative enough to find one through a wall.
creative+overconfident: A creative build that was declared indestructible by its overconfident designer, shortly before the first test.
creative+chaotic: A chaotic mess of ideas, at least one of them creative enough to win the round. Nobody is sure which.
creative+stubborn: A creative plan that deserved a second draft, defended to the end by its stubborn author.
creative+greedy: Greedy for the chest on the unreachable ledge, and creative enough to reach it with two boxes and a prayer.
creative+energetic: An energetic burst of creative plans, roughly one every ten seconds. The team got to pick a favourite.
creative+lucky: A creative idea that worked for reasons unrelated to the idea. Lucky, but the painting still counts.
creative+cautious: Creative with the solution and cautious with the testing: it was tried on a crate first, then on the boss.
creative+adventurous: Adventurous enough to leave the map and creative enough to find a use for whatever was out there.
creative+quiet: A quiet player off to one side, building something creative that nobody understood until it won the round.
creative+talkative: A talkative stream of creative ideas, pitched live. Some were brilliant, and all of them were out loud.
creative+sneaky: A sneaky route that nobody else knew existed, opened by a creative use of a door that was not a door.
creative+competitive: The Inventor of New Ways to Win
Competitive enough to need the win and creative enough to find a rule that technically allowed it.
patient+adaptable: Patient when the plan stalled and adaptable when it changed. This player simply waited, then walked a different way.
patient+encouraging: Patient through every failed jump and encouraging after each one. The seventh attempt got a round of applause.
patient+clutch: Patient for the entire round, then clutch for exactly one second. That second was the only one that mattered.
patient+reckless: Patient for nine minutes, reckless for one. The nine minutes were the setup, and the one was spectacular.
patient+distracted: Distracted by every side path and patient enough to explore each one fully. The objective was in no rush either.
patient+hesitant: It is hard to tell where patient ended and hesitant began, but the doorway was guarded very thoroughly.
patient+impatient: The Zen Master of Fast Forward
Patient with teammates and impatient with loading screens: endless calm for people, none at all for progress bars.
patient+overconfident: An overconfident prediction, followed by a patient wait for it to come true. It is still being waited on.
patient+chaotic: A chaotic round on every side, and one patient player standing in the middle of it, waiting for a gap.
patient+stubborn: Patient enough to wait and stubborn enough to never move. The other team gave up on that corner eventually.
patient+greedy: Patient enough to wait for the rare drop and greedy enough to wait for a second one.
patient+energetic: Energetic in every movement but patient about when to use it: the sprint was saved for exactly the right door.
patient+lucky: Patient enough to wait for the perfect moment, and lucky that the perfect moment walked right past.
patient+cautious: Patient and cautious to a professional standard: every trap was found, studied and politely walked around.
patient+adventurous: An adventurous route across the entire map, walked by someone patient enough to enjoy every step of it.
patient+quiet: The Statue in the Tall Grass
Quiet and patient for so long that the other team forgot this player existed. That was the plan.
patient+talkative: The Podcast in the Waiting Room
Patient through the longest queue of the night, and talkative enough to make it feel like a show.
patient+sneaky: The Ambush That Took All Day
A sneaky spot behind the crates and a patient wait inside it. The trap worked, about ten minutes later.
patient+competitive: Competitive about the result and patient about getting there: the lead came late, and it stayed.
adaptable+encouraging: Adaptable when the plan broke and encouraging about the new one: "this is fine, we go left now" has never sounded so convincing.
adaptable+clutch: The plan was gone, so this adaptable player made a new one in two seconds. The clutch finish was pure improvisation.
adaptable+reckless: A reckless dive into the wrong room, rescued by an adaptable mind that decided it was the right room after all.
adaptable+distracted: Distracted by a side quest, then adaptable enough to convince the team the side quest was the mission.
adaptable+hesitant: Hesitant at the start, adaptable by the end: it took a while to commit, but every change after that was handled.
adaptable+impatient: Too impatient to hear the whole plan, and adaptable enough that it did not matter.
adaptable+overconfident: An overconfident charge that should have ended badly, saved by an adaptable retreat that looked almost intentional.
adaptable+chaotic: A chaotic round that this adaptable player rode like a wave. Nothing went to plan, and it barely mattered.
adaptable+stubborn: Stubborn about the goal and adaptable about everything else: the destination never changed, only the six routes to it.
adaptable+greedy: Greedy for whatever dropped and adaptable enough to use it: this player changed class twice to match the loot.
adaptable+energetic: Energetic in every direction and adaptable at every bounce. Wherever the fight moved, this player was already there.
adaptable+lucky: Adaptable enough to land on both feet, and lucky that there was ground there.
adaptable+cautious: Cautious enough to expect trouble and adaptable enough to have packed for it.
adaptable+adventurous: Adventurous enough to leave the path and adaptable enough to cope with what was living out there.
adaptable+quiet: A quiet player who filled whichever role was empty. Adaptable to the point that nobody noticed the swap.
adaptable+talkative: Talkative for a useful reason: this adaptable player announced every change of plan as it happened.
adaptable+sneaky: A sneaky approach that changed three times on the way in. Adaptable enough that even the guards lost track.
adaptable+competitive: Competitive enough to want every edge and adaptable enough to switch tactics the moment one stopped working.
encouraging+clutch: Encouraging on the mic all round, then a clutch finish to back up every word of it.
encouraging+reckless: An encouraging voice behind every reckless idea: "you can make that jump" was said four times, and was wrong four times.
encouraging+distracted: Encouraging from somewhere far off the map. Distracted by a side quest, but the team could still hear the applause.
encouraging+hesitant: Hesitant to go first, but encouraging to whoever did. "You've got this" was shouted from a very safe distance.
encouraging+impatient: Encouraging and impatient at once: "you're doing great, now please do it faster."
encouraging+overconfident: Encouraging to the team and overconfident about the outcome: everyone was told the boss would be easy. It was not.
encouraging+chaotic: A chaotic round with an encouraging soundtrack. Nothing went right, and the cheering never stopped.
encouraging+stubborn: Stubborn about one thing only: this team can win. Encouraging through eleven attempts in a row.
encouraging+greedy: Encouraging the team to open every chest, and greedy enough to be standing next to each one when it opened.
encouraging+energetic: An energetic lap around the whole squad, with an encouraging word for each. Nobody asked, and everyone felt better.
encouraging+lucky: Encouraging words before the roll and a lucky result after it. The team has decided the two are connected.
encouraging+cautious: Cautious about the deep end and encouraging about the shallow one: small steps, loud applause.
encouraging+adventurous: An adventurous route into the unknown, with an encouraging voice at the front promising it was a shortcut.
encouraging+quiet: A quiet player who only spoke to say "nice one". Encouraging, in exactly as many words as needed.
encouraging+talkative: Talkative from start to finish and encouraging in every sentence. The pep talk lasted longer than the match.
encouraging+sneaky: A sneaky flank with an encouraging whisper on the way past: "keep them busy, you're doing great."
encouraging+competitive: The Captain of the Winning Mood
Competitive about the score and encouraging about the team: this player wants to win, and wants you there for it.
clutch+reckless: A reckless plan that had no right to work, finished with a clutch landing that made it look sensible.
clutch+distracted: Distracted for most of the round, then back just in time for the clutch play. An entrance, at least.
clutch+hesitant: Hesitant right up to the final second, and clutch in it. The pause, it turns out, was dramatic timing.
clutch+impatient: The Buzzer Beater in a Hurry
Too impatient to wait for the team, which is how the clutch play ended up being a solo.
clutch+overconfident: An overconfident promise before the round and a clutch play at the end of it. For once, the two matched.
clutch+chaotic: A chaotic round that should have been lost four times, rescued by one clutch play nobody can explain.
clutch+stubborn: Too stubborn to go down with the rest of the squad, and clutch enough to make that the winning decision.
clutch+greedy: Greedy enough to go back for one more chest, and clutch enough to escape with it while the room collapsed.
clutch+energetic: Energetic all round and somehow more so at the end, when the clutch play arrived at a full sprint.
clutch+lucky: The Coin That Landed on Its Edge
The team is split on whether that was a clutch play or a lucky one. This player is firmly on one side.
clutch+cautious: Cautious for nine minutes so that the tenth could be clutch. Nothing was risked until it had to be.
clutch+adventurous: An adventurous route that put the whole round in doubt, resolved by a clutch finish at the very last ledge.
clutch+quiet: A quiet player all match, with nothing to say before the clutch play and nothing to add after it.
clutch+talkative: Talkative enough to announce the play in advance and clutch enough to deliver it exactly as described.
clutch+sneaky: A sneaky route nobody was watching, and a clutch capture at the end of it. The other team found out from the scoreboard.
clutch+competitive: Competitive from the first second, and clutch in the last one. This is the round this player showed up for.
reckless+distracted: A reckless sprint in one direction, then a distracted swerve in another. The objective was in neither.
reckless+hesitant: Hesitant for a full minute, then reckless for three seconds. There was no setting in between.
reckless+impatient: Too impatient to wait for the plan and too reckless to need one. The door never stood a chance.
reckless+overconfident: An overconfident countdown, a reckless charge, and a very short fight. The speech beforehand was excellent.
reckless+chaotic: A reckless entrance into a chaotic fight, which it made noticeably worse. Enjoyably worse.
reckless+stubborn: A reckless charge at the front gate, repeated by a stubborn attacker until either the gate or the plan gave way.
reckless+greedy: Greedy for the chest in the lava room and reckless enough to go and get it. The chest is fine.
reckless+energetic: An energetic launch in a reckless direction. Nobody could steer it, so the team just watched.
reckless+lucky: The Stunt Double With Nine Lives
A reckless leap into the unknown, followed by a lucky landing nobody can explain.
reckless+cautious: The Bungee Jumper With Two Ropes
Cautious right up until the moment it mattered, then gloriously reckless. The team is still deciding which one helped.
reckless+adventurous: An adventurous path into the unknown, taken at a reckless speed. Several new areas were discovered, briefly.
reckless+quiet: A quiet player who said nothing at all before the reckless jump. The team found out from the splash.
reckless+talkative: A reckless plan, announced in full by a talkative pilot on the way in. The team had time to object and didn't.
reckless+sneaky: A sneaky approach for the first half and a reckless one for the second. The guards noticed the second half.
reckless+competitive: Competitive enough to want the win right now, and reckless enough to bet the whole round on one push.
distracted+hesitant: Hesitant about which way to go, then distracted by a third option that was not on the list.
distracted+impatient: Too impatient to finish one objective and too distracted to start the next. Six things are now half done.
distracted+overconfident: An overconfident claim to be handling everything at once, made by a distracted player handling none of it.
distracted+chaotic: A distracted wander in the wrong direction set off a chaotic chain of events that nobody has fully traced.
distracted+stubborn: Distracted by a side quest, and far too stubborn to leave it unfinished while the main fight carried on.
distracted+greedy: Greedy for anything that glittered and distracted by all of it. The objective did not glitter.
distracted+energetic: An energetic sprint in the right direction, then a distracted one in four others.
distracted+lucky: Distracted for the whole fight, and lucky enough to wander through it untouched and collect the flag.
distracted+cautious: Cautious enough to check every corner, and distracted enough to check ones in a different building.
distracted+adventurous: Distracted by a path and adventurous enough to follow it to the end. The team has been sent a postcard.
distracted+quiet: A quiet player, possibly distracted, possibly making a sandwich. The character stood very still for a while.
distracted+talkative: The Storyteller Who Missed the Fight
Talkative about something unrelated and distracted by telling it. The boss was beaten somewhere around chapter two.
distracted+sneaky: The Burglar Who Stopped for Snacks
A sneaky route around the guards, paused halfway by a distracted look inside a barrel.
distracted+competitive: The Rival of the Wrong Thing
Competitive about a minigame nobody else was playing, and too distracted by it to notice the actual score.
hesitant+impatient: Impatient to get going and hesitant to actually go: a lot of pacing happened in front of that door.
hesitant+overconfident: The Brave Speech, Then the Pause
Overconfident in the lobby and hesitant at the boss door. The speech and the footsteps did not match.
hesitant+chaotic: A chaotic fight broke out, and one hesitant player stood in the middle of it deciding what to do first.
hesitant+stubborn: Hesitant to go in, and stubborn about not being rushed. The door and this player reached an understanding eventually.
hesitant+greedy: Greedy for the loot and hesitant about the trap: the chest was circled four times before it was opened.
hesitant+energetic: The Jogger at the Red Light
Energetic on the spot and hesitant to leave it. A great deal of running happened without much distance.
hesitant+lucky: The Late Arrival Who Missed the Trap
Hesitant for just long enough that the trap went off without anyone in it. Lucky, and never to be admitted.
hesitant+cautious: Cautious about the room and hesitant about the door to it. Both were inspected thoroughly, from outside.
hesitant+adventurous: The Diver on the High Board
Adventurous enough to climb all the way up there, and hesitant enough to stand at the edge for a while.
hesitant+quiet: A quiet figure near the doorway, hesitant to step through it. Nobody hurried things along, and that was appreciated.
hesitant+talkative: Hesitant to choose a route and talkative about why: the team heard the full case for both.
hesitant+sneaky: A sneaky plan, ready to go, and a hesitant pause behind the crate while it was rehearsed one more time.
hesitant+competitive: The Athlete at the Starting Block
Competitive enough to badly want the win and hesitant about the first move that might lose it.
impatient+overconfident: Too impatient to wait for backup and overconfident enough not to need it. Backup arrived for the respawn.
impatient+chaotic: Too impatient for the countdown, which is how the chaotic part started eleven seconds early.
impatient+stubborn: Impatient with the locked door and stubborn about it: the same button was pressed forty times, faster each time.
impatient+greedy: Greedy for the loot and too impatient to wait for the room to be cleared first.
impatient+energetic: Energetic and impatient in the same body: already at the objective while the briefing was still on slide one.
impatient+lucky: Too impatient to wait for a good opportunity, and lucky enough that one turned up anyway.
impatient+cautious: Impatient to get going, cautious about actually going. No doorway has ever been examined so quickly.
impatient+adventurous: Too impatient for the main road and adventurous enough to try the cliff instead. It was faster, technically.
impatient+quiet: A quiet player who never complained out loud. The impatient sprint ahead of the group said enough.
impatient+talkative: Impatient and talkative together: "are we going, are we going now, how about now" was most of the briefing.
impatient+sneaky: A sneaky plan that needed a slow approach, carried out by someone too impatient to walk.
impatient+competitive: Competitive about the result and impatient for the next one: the rematch was requested before the scores appeared.
overconfident+chaotic: An overconfident promise that everything was under control, made from the centre of a very chaotic room.
overconfident+stubborn: Overconfident about the plan and stubborn when it started sinking. The ship went down mid-reassurance.
overconfident+greedy: Greedy for the biggest chest and overconfident about the guardian sitting on it. One of those was a miscalculation.
overconfident+energetic: An energetic victory lap, run slightly before the match. Overconfident, but the form was good.
overconfident+lucky: The Prophet Who Got Away With It

overconfident+cautious: Cautious in every action and overconfident in every sentence: the boasting was done from behind solid cover.
overconfident+adventurous: An adventurous route, led by an overconfident guide who had never been there and said so only afterwards.
overconfident+quiet: A quiet player who said almost nothing. The overconfident walk into the boss room said the rest.
overconfident+talkative: Talkative before the round and overconfident in every answer. The post-game conference was shorter.
overconfident+sneaky: A sneaky entrance, spoiled slightly by the overconfident wave at the guards on the way past.
overconfident+competitive: Competitive about the title and overconfident enough to be clearing a shelf for it at half-time.
chaotic+stubborn: A chaotic approach that clearly was not working, repeated by a stubborn player until it somehow did.
chaotic+greedy: A greedy dash for every chest at once, which turned a tidy room into a chaotic one in about four seconds.
chaotic+energetic: Energetic and chaotic in every direction at once. The enemy could not predict it, and neither could the team.
chaotic+lucky: A chaotic chain of accidents that ended in a win. Lucky is one word for it, and the only one available.
chaotic+cautious: Cautious in theory and chaotic in practice: the trap was checked very carefully, then set off anyway.
chaotic+adventurous: The Expedition That Got Out of Hand
An adventurous idea that became a chaotic one about a minute in. Nobody regrets it, exactly.
chaotic+quiet: A quiet player at the centre of a chaotic round, offering no explanation for any of it.
chaotic+talkative: A chaotic fight with a talkative narrator in the middle, describing a different fight entirely.
chaotic+sneaky: A sneaky plan that turned chaotic the moment it began. Nobody saw this player, mostly because nobody could see anything.
chaotic+competitive: Competitive about winning and chaotic about how. The scoreboard was climbed by a route nobody else would try.
stubborn+greedy: Greedy enough to claim the whole pile and stubborn enough to stand on it for the rest of the round.
stubborn+energetic: Energetic and stubborn in a straight line: straight into the wall, bounce, and straight into it again.
stubborn+lucky: A stubborn refusal to change tactics, finally rewarded on the ninth try by a lucky break.
stubborn+cautious: Cautious about leaving cover and stubborn about staying in it. The other team ran out of ideas first.
stubborn+adventurous: The Explorer Who Refused the Map
An adventurous route that was plainly a dead end, followed all the way by a stubborn traveller to make sure.
stubborn+quiet: A quiet player who did not argue with the plan. The stubborn decision to do something else was made in silence.
stubborn+talkative: Stubborn about the route and talkative in its defence: the debate outlasted the round it was about.
stubborn+sneaky: A sneaky route that kept getting spotted, tried again and again by a stubborn player until the guards got bored.
stubborn+competitive: Competitive enough to hate losing and stubborn enough to keep asking for one more round until it stopped being a loss.
greedy+energetic: An energetic sweep of the whole level, with a greedy stop at everything that could be picked up.
greedy+lucky: Greedy enough to open the cursed chest and lucky enough that the curse was on holiday.
greedy+cautious: Greedy for the treasure and cautious about the lid: it was opened eventually, with a very long stick.
greedy+adventurous: Adventurous enough to cross the whole map for one rumour of loot, and greedy enough to check it was true.
greedy+quiet: A quiet player who never mentioned the chest. A greedy backpack mentioned it later.

energetic+lucky: Energetic enough to try everything at once, and lucky enough that one of those things was the right one.
energetic+cautious: Energetic between the doors and cautious at each one: sprint, stop, peek, sprint again.

energetic+quiet: A quiet player who never announced a thing. The energetic trail of finished objectives did that.

energetic+competitive: Competitive from the warm-up and energetic to the final whistle. Every round got treated like a final.
lucky+cautious: Cautious enough to check every trap and lucky enough that the one they missed was broken.
lucky+adventurous: An adventurous wrong turn that ended at the treasure room. Lucky, and now officially the plan.
lucky+quiet: A quiet player who said nothing about the lucky drop. The glowing sword gave it away.
lucky+talkative: A lucky shot, followed by a talkative explanation of exactly how it was planned.
lucky+sneaky: The Ghost Who Found the Back Door

lucky+competitive: Competitive enough to count every win, including the lucky ones. Especially those.
cautious+adventurous: The Explorer With a Packed Lunch
Adventurous enough to leave the path and cautious enough to tie a rope to it first.
cautious+quiet: Quiet footsteps and a cautious look around every corner. Nothing was triggered, and nothing was said.
cautious+talkative: Cautious about every room and talkative about every risk: the team has now heard the full list.
cautious+sneaky: Sneaky and cautious to a professional standard: no alarms, no footprints, and the door closed behind them.
cautious+competitive: Competitive enough to want the lead and cautious enough to sit on it for the rest of the round.
adventurous+quiet: A quiet player who wandered off on an adventurous route and came back with half the map uncovered.
adventurous+talkative: An adventurous trip to the far corner of the map, described by a talkative guide for the whole journey.
adventurous+sneaky: Adventurous enough to try the suspicious wall and sneaky enough to use what was behind it.

quiet+talkative: Quiet for the first half and talkative for the second, with no warning in between. The team enjoyed both.

quiet+competitive: A quiet player who never mentioned the score, and a competitive one who knew it to the point.

talkative+competitive: Competitive about every point and talkative about each one: the score was read out, with analysis.
